description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galgana, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510219
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and title classifications. The content focuses on land registration and property rights rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories.
